models.H1: percentage gate: per-hit = D x (1 - strength/100)
models.H2: threshold gate + pool: D <= strength absorbed, else ceil((armor + HP) / D)

probes.question: is the armour strength a percentage gate (H1) or a per-hit threshold (H2)?
probes.setup: one tank shell into the Batmobile's body, at the centre of the 8 m blast
probes.why: strength 50 makes H1 halve the 1500 blast; H2 lets it through because 1500 > 50. The explosion channel is the only one where the two models disagree at a testable count

probes.H1: 200 rounds x 0.3 = 60 damage, bar barely moves, no destruction
probes.question: does the bullet gate at strength 99 leak 1 % (H1) or absorb everything up to strength (H2)?
probes.setup: 200 pistol rounds at the body, health read before and after
probes.why: H0 and H1/H2 are separated by 3 orders of magnitude; H1 vs H2 is 60 HP vs 0 HP on a 2000 HP bar (3 %) - readable only if the HUD shows a number. If test-077's failure was small-arms damage, H1 is already falsified for this channel

probes.question: does an emptied armour pool take the hit instead of health (H2 pool half)?
probes.setup: two tank shells into a stock medium tank (explosion_armor 250). Not the donor: its pool is 0, so H2 collapses to H0 there and the pool half cannot be seen
probes.why: the pool half of H2 is invisible on the donor (armour 0) and only shows on a vehicle with a non-zero pool
